chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Khalid, all from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn Imran, from Harun ibn Kharja, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When you bring forth the deceased, say: 'In the name of Allah, and by Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). O Allah, to Your mercy, not to Your punishment.' So when you place him in the grave niche, place your hand on his ear and say: 'Allah is your Lord, and Islam is your religion, and Muhammad is your Prophet, and the Quran is your Book, and Ali is your Imam.'

key_terms.سَلَلْتَ: To bring forth or carry out (the deceased)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended supplications and actions when burying the deceased in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes the ritual of 'salal' (carrying the deceased) and the specific dhikr recited at the grave's entrance, emphasizing the transition from this world to divine mercy. The creedal declaration uniquely highlights 'Ali (AS) as the Imam, reflecting the Shia theological emphasis on Imamate as an integral component of faith alongside the Prophet and the Quran.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed and Muhammad Bin Khalid, altogether from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran, from Haroun Bin Kharja, from Abu Baseer, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When you bring forth the deceased, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, and by Allahazwj, and upon the Religion of Rasool-Allahsaww. O Allahazwj! To Yourazwj Mercy, not to Yourazwj Punishment’. So when you place him into the chasm (Lahad), so place your hand upon his ear and say, ‘Allahazwj is your Lordazwj, and Al Islam is your Religion, and Muhammadsaww is your Prophetsaww, and the Quran is your Book, and Aliasws is your Imamasws’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id and Muhammad ibn Khalid, all from al-Nadr ibn al-Suwayd from Yahya ibn ‘Imran from Harun ibn Kharijah from abu Basir who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said to say this, when you place a deceased in the grave, ‘(I begin) in the name of Allah, with Allah and on the path of the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, take him to Your mercy and not to Your punishment.’ Say, when the deceased is placed in the grave, with your hand on his ear, ‘Allah is your Lord, al-Islam is your religion, Muhammad is your prophet, Quran is your book and Ali is your Imam.’”
